correctness.rationale: Direct finite-energy calculation proves the four-colour local inequality. Exact transfer-walk bijection and equitable quotient yield symbolic determinants x*p_A and x*p_F. Constructive reachability plus reflection yields primitive full graphs, so their quotient Perron roots equal the full transfer growth constants. Strict row sums give lambda_A<q. Identity p_A-p_F=t^2(q-t) implies p_F(lambda_A)<0, producing a real ferromagnetic eigenvalue larger than lambda_A, and hence the strict inequality. verify.py checks symbolic identities, finite energies, and full q=3 charpoly.

value.rationale: The natural entropy of blocked configurations is an invariant of strictly decreasing conserving spin dynamics. The ferromagnet/antiferromagnet transformation changes locally admissible words, and the resulting universal strict entropy ordering is extensive; an exact five-state quotient and quartic identity explain it. For q=3 the previously absent cubic AF growth constant and full characteristic-polynomial finite-ring enumeration provide an independent nontrivial all-size fact.
